result.reason: The added clause includes all preferred coverages and limits, appropriately requires cyber/privacy coverage because TrueLink processes Client data, and provides for certificates upon request. It leaves the unrelated force majeure provision unchanged. However, requiring every policy to remain in place for one year after termination is not in the playbook and is broader than necessary, particularly for CGL and workers’ compensation; any post-term requirement should be limited to applicable claims-made coverage or an appropriate extended reporting period.
